name: SEAL
recent: SEAL 将于 2026 年 12 月 4 日召开第 64 届常年股东大会，并已就向 24.55% 联营公司 MSR Green Energy 提供额外财务援助（企业担保）取得股东通过。公司同时宣布与 Titanium Greenview 的策略合作条件先决期限延长至 2027 年 1 月 31 日。近期董事与主要股东持续申报买卖公司股份。
notable: 股东通过向 24.55% 联营公司 MSR Green Energy 提供企业担保形式的额外财务援助。
与 Titanium Greenview 的策略合作（认购 Mutiara Waterfront Habitats 新股至 82.34% 扩大后股本）条件先决期限延长至 2027 年 1 月 31 日。
将于 2026 年 12 月 4 日召开第 64 届常年股东大会。
risks: 公司为联营公司 MSR Green Energy 的银行融资及外汇合约提供企业担保，承担额外财务援助风险。
董事 Datuk Wira Syed Amir Syakib Arsalan bin Syed Ibrahim 在 2026 年 10 月多次申报买卖公司股份。
主要股东 Ong Kah Hui 于 2026 年 10 月申报权益变动。

events.what: 策略合作条件先决期限

recent_en: The company also announced an extension of the conditions precedent deadline for its strategic collaboration with Titanium Greenview to 31 January 2027. Directors and a substantial shareholder have been reporting ongoing dealings in the company's shares.
notable_en: Shareholders approved additional financial assistance to 24.55%-owned associate MSR Green Energy in the form of a corporate guarantee.

The conditions precedent deadline for the strategic collaboration with Titanium Greenview (subscription of new shares for 82.34% of the enlarged share capital of Mutiara Waterfront Habitats) was extended to 31 January 2027.
The 64th AGM will be held on 4 December 2026.
risks_en: The company is providing a corporate guarantee for MSR Green Energy's banking and foreign exchange contract facilities, exposing it to additional financial assistance risk.
Director Datuk Wira Syed Amir Syakib Arsalan bin Syed Ibrahim reported multiple dealings in the company's shares in October 2026.
Substantial shareholder Ong Kah Hui reported changes in interest in October 2026.
